create_YolosImageProcessor: create a YolosImageProcessor instance for preprocessing images and annotations for YOLOS object detection models
run_YolosImageProcessor_preprocess: run the YolosImageProcessor preprocess method to resize, pad, normalize images and convert COCO annotations for model input
run_YolosImageProcessor_post_process_obj: run the YolosImageProcessor post_process_object_detection method to convert model logits and bounding boxes into final detection results
build_prepare_coco_detection_annotation: build a prepare_coco_detection_annotation call to convert COCO detection annotations into YOLOS target format with boxes, classes, and area
build_convert_coco_poly_to_mask: build a convert_coco_poly_to_mask call to convert COCO polygon segmentation annotations into binary mask tensors
